note: USA targets are strategic and deliberately aggressive (Hutong NYC explicitly so), and September targets step up again at Aqua NYC, so weekly and year-to-date variances read heavily negative by design. Weekly target = September monthly GA4 target x 7/30; Hutong Miami’s GA4 target is derived from its Meta plan x 6,738/4,756 and is flagged as not directly comparable. The portfolio booked 448 GA4 bookings against a 996 blended weekly target, up 2.5 percent week on week and down 35.6 percent year on year. Two of three venues were up week on week. The year-on-year picture is distorted by unusual 2025 bases: the year-ago week carried 1,556 Paid Other sessions at Aqua NYC (17 this year) and 1,876 Organic Social sessions at Hutong Miami (122 this year), which is most of the apparent decline. Conversion is the more useful read and it is up at every venue: Hutong NYC 5.5 percent against 3.8 percent last year, Hutong Miami 4.4 against 3.8. Aqua NYC is the exception at 4.4 percent against 7.9 percent last year. Covers, reported separately, are down only 6.1 percent year on year against GA4’s 35.6 percent, because GA4 cannot see OpenTable or Resy.
